youtube_title: Eyes Burning After 8 Hours Of Screen? Use The 20-20-20 Rule | Body Fix #23 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #23. 8 hours of laptop, 2 hours of phone... and your eyes BURN at night?
B is right. 20-20-20: every 20 MIN, look 20 FEET away for 20 SEC.
On screens we blink much less. Eyes dry out and focus muscles tire.
Fix: Set a timer, blink on purpose, screen not brighter than the room, arm's length away.
Red flags: Blurry vision that stays, daily headaches, red painful eye? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: AAO - Digital eye strain / 20-20-20
